name: Wsprry Pi Standard Feld RadioLib Simplified 5x5 Font v1
checksum_procedure: SHA-256 over the committed UTF-8 file bytes

provenance.derivation: All 64 five-row source records transcribed byte-for-byte into JSON; expansion adds one blank logical row above and below, then duplicates every logical row into two physical positions

transmitted_geometry.expansion: blank logical row, five stored image rows, blank logical row; duplicate each logical row into two physical positions

repertoire.accepted_additional_input: U+0061 through U+007A normalized to U+0041 through U+005A
repertoire.input_encoding: UTF-8 restricted after decoding to the stated ASCII repertoire
repertoire.unsupported_behavior: reject the complete message before output

known_limitations: Simplified modern artwork, not a historical Tbs 24a drum transcription
All vertical logical pixels use fixed physical-position pairs even though the protocol permits arbitrary half-position placement
The prior fldigi-to-xfhell F3 result does not transfer to this asset
Exact-asset clean and impaired interoperability remains Phase 3 work
